title: Catalogue of conquered kings
english: [[These are the kings Jesus struck >> Bible:Joshua 12:7-24]] — a victory catalogue. Each vice’s prince must be named and laid low.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: From the wadi to Hermon
english: From the Arnon torrent to Hermon — victory’s bounds. Christ’s kingdom stretches from low things to high.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Moses’ kings and Jesus’ kings
english: Moses struck Sihon and Og; Jesus the kings west of Jordan. The law runs ahead; Christ completes. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
